_comment: Supplier credentials per environment. Copy to config/credentials.json (gitignored), fill in, chmod 600, then `make credentials-import env=<env>` (dry run) and add write=1 to apply. Empty strings are skipped, never written as blanks; a field name the slot does not define is refused. Fields: contracts/src/credentials.js, or `make credential-set env=<env> slot=<slot>`.
